sample_unit: junior ICU clinicians (physicians and nurses) in reader study

links.outcome: Junior clinician PICC tip accuracy and reading time with versus without AI, versus standalone AI
links.effect: Standalone AI 90.0% accuracy; clinicians alone mean 13.3%; with AI 95.0% (p<0.001); time fell from 20.8 s to 9.72 s (p<0.001). Assisted accuracy exceeded standalone.
links.quote: When assisted by the AI tool, their diagnostic accuracy improved approximately 7-fold to 95.0% (p < 0.001), while interpretation time was reduced by more than half to 9.72 seconds (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the impact of an AI-assisted point-of-care tool on junior ICU clinicians' diagnostic accuracy and reading speed via a reader study comparing performance with versus without AI assistance.
